clips.send: A parent sends it to anyone popping a multivitamin instead of fixing what's actually on their plate - the quiet worry they've been doing it wrong for years.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau names a cause of illness that used to rank first, and says it still deserves more attention: nutritional deficiency - missing calcium, magnesium, minerals, certain vitamins.

His correction on the word itself: 'supplement' means in addition to, not instead of. A pill only fills gaps in an already good diet - it was never built to replace it.

His real-world point: nobody's growing and pickling their own food for winter, so most people eat out or buy conventional some days. His rule: supplement in addition to your diet, and do the best you can with what's realistic.

What's missing from your plate this week?
